mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_run (run_id, turn_id, tenant_id, user_id, session_id, source_type, source_id, status, version, base_context_revision, current_context_revision, predecessor_run_id, successor_run_id, user_message_id, steer_instruction, terminal_reason, cancel_requested_at, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{runId}, #{turnId}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{status}, #{version}, #{baseContextRevision}, #{currentContextRevision}, #{predecessorRunId}, #{successorRunId}, #{userMessageId}, #{steerInstruction}, #{terminalReason}, #{cancelRequestedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_run WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND deleted = 0 AND (tenant_id IS NULL OR tenant_id = '')AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM chat_run WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND deleted = 0 AND (tenant_id IS NULL OR tenant_id = '')AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_run SET status = #{targetStatus}, version = version + 1, terminal_reason = COALESCE(#{reason}, terminal_reason), cancel_requested_at = COALESCE(#{cancelRequestedAt}, cancel_requested_at), started_at = CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} = 'running' THEN COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ELSE started_at END, finished_at = COALESCE(#{finishedAt}, finished_at) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND deleted = 0 AND (tenant_id IS NULL OR tenant_id = '')AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
